text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, after winning numerous races together with Smart Falcon—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She asked to use the "Hot Springs Trip Voucher"
won in the lottery earlier, so we came on this reward trip, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"H-O-T-S-P-R-I-N-G☆ I love 'em~♪
Hot Spring Anthem~♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—That was our hot springs song medley!
Brought to you by Falco~☆”

text_block_list.name: Elderly People
text_block_list.text:
Look at you go, little lady!
Aren't you adorable?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For some reason, Smart Falcon had crashed a banquet for a group on a company retreat.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, didn't I just tell you all?
It's not "little lady," it's Fa-l-co♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Say what?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Person A
text_block_list.text: Waru... ko?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Person B
text_block_list.text: You were great, Waruko-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, no, nooo!
You've got it all wrong!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is an ultra-orthodox Umadol!
Which means I'm a super good girl~!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next is a duet song special☆
The Falco & Trainer unit is taking the stage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after that, the lively
banquet continued—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haaah, sang my heart out!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Same to you, Trainer.
Thanks for hanging out with me!
choice_data_list: You really surprised me when you jumped in unannounced.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, sorry☆
I just couldn't help it when I heard the singing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "If there is a stage, stand upon it wherever it may be! That's the iron rule of Umadols♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad everyone had fun.
Falco's song brought out full-bloom smiles☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Being an Umadol really is
the absolute best♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even on a reward vacation, she never forgets her Umadol spirit.
Singing, dancing, and making someone smile.
That itself is her reward.
choice_data_list: I'm glad Falco looks like she's having fun

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehe, that was fun☆
choice_data_list: Let's get some proper rest afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “Yeah! Let's soak in the hot springs and get our skin silky smooth and shiny~♪”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Pheww... That was a wonderful bath♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, really...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, can I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
did you have fun with Falco?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've run recklessly alongside Falco
all the way up to this point, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've chased nothing but reckless dreams, haven't I?
I'm sure it must have been tough on you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering which was bigger—
the hardship, or the fun.
choice_data_list: Of course, the fun far outweighs it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I see~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"If you've made peace and kept them as fond memories...
it's okay to move on to the next step, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Rather than someone who has already fulfilled their dream,
I want to support a rough diamond who is just heading toward one.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Some fans do end up
stepping down as their supporters like that.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I think that's just unavoidable.
It's not that Falco's shine has faded,
it's just that they were drawn to a different kind of shine.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer... if you ever
want to dream a different dream—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Won't you show me your next brilliance?
Will you show me your next brilliance?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Me too.
Always, and forever, to you—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I was just so touched thinking about
what a diehard Falco-fan you are!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right, Falco's decided!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna shine brighter and waaay brighter!
So bright that your eyes might just pop out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah!?
That was just a figure of speech!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco was being such a klutz☆
Tee-hee♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond
between myself and Smart Falcon...
